series_start_reason: Lilly prints Trajenta (its spelling) quarterly only from the 2015 filings. Lilly's own 8-Ks and 10-Qs for 2011-2014 carry no Trajenta row (measured: every table row whose first cell is Trajenta, over every Lilly 8-K, 10-Q and 10-K 2011-2026); the 2014 10-K gives full years only (2012 88.6, 2013 249.2, 2014 328.8). 2014Q1-Q3 are read from the prior-year columns of the 2015 10-Qs and 2014Q4 is the 2014 full year less those nine months; nothing earlier is citable quarterly.

approval_evidence.quote: TRADJENTA LINAGLIPTIN 5MG TABLET;ORAL ... 05/02/2011 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity

search_log: Listed every Lilly filing via data.sec.gov submissions (all forms) and took 8-K item 2.02 filings with every exhibit, plus 10-Q and 10-K, 2011-2026.

Extracted every HTML table row whose first cell starts with Trajenta/Tradjenta (scripts/lilly_rows.py). The line is in 10-Q revenue tables through 2020Q3 (and the 2015 and 2018 release product tables) and in the 10-Q BI collaboration note from 2021Q1 through 2024Q3.
Q4 rows are 10-K full year (collaboration-note row) less the Q3 10-Q nine months, except 2018Q4 (printed in the Q4 2018 release) and 2017Q4 (prior-year column of that release).

Lilly's release footnote: 'Trajenta includes Jentadueto'. Boehringer Ingelheim (private) is not a source: contract allows only issuer-published documents and BI publishes annual figures only (not retrieved or checked).

From 2024Q4 the rows come from Lilly's quarterly Financial Workbooks (investor.lilly.com Quarterly Results, sheet 'Revenue', row 'Trajenta(4)', footnote 'Trajenta revenue includes Jentadueto'), Total column; the same line as the 10-Q collaboration-note rows (2024Q1-Q3 88.9, 76.6, 91.7 agree with the workbook). The host returns 403 to automated downloads.

launch_evidence.quote: In the second quarter of 2011, linagliptin was approved (tradename Tradjenta™) and launched in the U.S.

notes: Series continues to 2026Q2 on the workbook line; the earlier statement that Lilly stopped printing the product after 2024Q3 does not hold.
